scientific_intent.application_domain: Computational imaging / direct complex Fourier adjoint sum
scientific_intent.scientific_operator: Accumulate positive-exponential complex Fourier contributions from complexmu and kcoordinates into samplepositions, including initialoutput
scientific_intent.numerical_method: Source4096voxel chunks, ordered Float32 accumulation and CUDAfastSFU sin/cos, actual49152Bconstant symbol
scientific_intent.community_use: Fourier projection/adjoint primitive in imaging andspectralcomputation; not full MRIreconstruction or medicalaccuracy experiment
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Fullcomplexoutput against independentFloat64complexfsum with prospectiveatol1e-4 rtol2e-5, analyticzero/singlemodecontrols, exactallinputbits/guards andfullconstanttailreadback
limitations: Boundedphase dyadicfixtures andsinglechunkboundary, no broadlargeargument SFUclaim
CUDAbackend AS4/driverinterop, no crossbackend capability claim
